meta.description: See what is wrong in your area, vote on India's most pressing causes, know your MP and MLA, and check every promise against the evidence.

footer.about: An independent, non-partisan civic project, not affiliated with any government body, political party or religion. Every claim on this site links to a public source.
footer.made: Made in India, for the citizens of India
footer.translations: Translations are a first version. Spotted a mistake? Tell us on the contact page.

home.lead: TrackBharat shows what is happening in your locality, which causes India is voting on this week, and whether your MP and MLA kept their word. Start with your PIN code.
home.motto: We are not from any party or any religion. Our only motto is transparency: India deserves to see the truth.
home.whatTitle: What we do, in three steps
home.step1Title: Tell us what's wrong in your locality
home.step1Body: Broken roads, no water, unsafe streets. Post it with a photo; neighbours confirm or dispute it.
home.step2Title: Vote on India's Causes of the Week
home.step2Body: Every Monday we pick the most common problems across India. Vote up if it affects you, down if it doesn't.
home.step3Title: Know your neta, check their promises
home.step3Body: Your MP and MLA, what they promised, what they did, and how active they are in Parliament.
home.manifestoBody: What the parties wrote in their manifestos, and what happened next. Every line links to the original document.
home.timelineBody: Founders, leaders, missions and milestones, told the same way for every party.
home.principle1Body: No source, no claim. Promises, news and evidence link to the original document.
home.principle2Body: The same rules and the same formula for every party and every representative.
home.principle3Body: Everything you can see, you can download. Researchers and journalists are welcome.

vote.verifyToCount: Verify your email so your vote counts

causes.title: India's Causes of the Week
causes.lead: Picked every Monday from the problems citizens reported most across India. Vote up if it affects you, down if it doesn't, and share it so others can verify.
causes.empty: This week's causes are picked on Monday morning. Report a problem in your area to help decide them.

news.title: News that needs a voice
news.lead: Short, sourced summaries of stories that affect citizens, with the district, state and who is responsible. Every story links to the original report.
news.submitLead: Seen an under-reported story? Send the link. A verifier checks it and writes a short summary before it is published.

parties.title: Manifestos: promised vs done
parties.lead: What each party promised before an election, and what happened next. Only promises we can link to the original manifesto are listed; 'not yet rated' means we have not found enough evidence either way.
parties.scoreOf: Of {n} promises made while in power

timeline.title: How India's parties evolved
timeline.lead: Founders, leaders, missions and milestones, told the same way for every party. Dates and sources only, no praise and no blame.

neta.title: Know Your Neta
neta.lead: Every sitting MP and MLA, by state and party. Open a seat to see promises, questions asked in Parliament and the report card.
neta.noMla: MLA data for this state isn't loaded yet.

common.englishOnly: This page is available in English only for now.

auth.forgotLead: Enter your email. If an account exists, we'll send a link to choose a new password.
auth.forgotSent: If that email has an account, a reset link is on its way. It works for 30 minutes.
auth.resetDone: Password changed. You can log in now.
auth.verifyDone: Email verified. Your votes now count.
auth.verifyFailed: This link is invalid or has expired. Ask for a new one from your account page.
auth.verifyBanner: Verify your email so your votes count in the rankings.
